title: These large- and mid-cap stocks can give more than 25% return in 1 year, according to analysts
summary: Looking at what happens in the short term is important, as it does have an impact on stock prices. But also always keep an eye on the macro picture. Consider, for instance, this important change: FIIs are no longer the only large source of equity flows. DII money has become much more significant over the years. That does not make the market immune to foreign selling; but it does mean that sustained selling by FIIs need not produce the kind of market reaction it once did.

title: Major players Lenskart, Groww, Adani Energy join MSCI India Index
summary: MSCI announced changes to India indices, adding four stocks and removing three.  India's weight in the MSCI India Standard Index will rise slightly to 11.9 percent. These changes will take effect on August 31, impacting fund flows.
